archetypes.name: dyn-oos-cap-flow
archetypes.rationale: Checks cap enforcement before aggregation artifacts are written.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the design and implement collection paths changed in python/plan_review_round.py and python/review_pipeline.py. Verify each reviewer identity has an independent OOS allowance, overflow OOS rows are dropped before ballot output, later in-scope rows still flow through, and numbering remains dense. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-prompt-sync
archetypes.rationale: Checks generated and live prompt surfaces stay aligned.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the OOS cap wording across skills/shared/reviewer-templates.md, hand-maintained reviewer agents, generated agents, pre-rendered bodies, and python/rendering.py. Verify generated artifacts match their sources and dynamic reviewer prompts receive equivalent materiality and overflow guidance. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
